A reflection is its own inverse; a quarter turn is undone by a quarter turn the other way; a half turn is its own inverse; an enlargement with scale factor k is undone by scale factor \(\frac{1}{k}\).

questiondescription.text:
Matrices and Transformations: inverses of named transformations

Grade 12 CBE Core 2.1: Name the inverse of reflections, rotations about O and an enlargement with centre O.

Core

This question is original to this project.

INNODEMS CBC Grade 12 Mathematics, first draft by Ben Davies, 2026. Aligned to the KICD Senior School Curriculum Design, Core Mathematics Grade 12 (draft).

truefeedback.text: [[if test="is(R1=\"enl\")"]]A scale factor of \({@-kk@}\) does not undo a scale factor of \({@kk@}\): it multiplies distances from O by \({@abs(kk)@}\) again. The inverse multiplies them by \(1 \div {@kk@}\).[[else]][[if test="is(R1=\"r90\" or R1=\"r270\")"]]Doing the same quarter turn again turns the shape further, not back. Turn through the same angle the other way.[[else]][[if test="is(R1=\"rx\" or R1=\"ry\" or R1=\"ryx\" or R1=\"rmyx\")"]]Reflecting in the [[if test="is(E1=\"rx\")"]]x-axis[[/if]][[if test="is(E1=\"ry\")"]]y-axis[[/if]][[if test="is(E1=\"ryx\")"]]line \(y = x\)[[/if]][[if test="is(E1=\"rmyx\")"]]line \(y = -x\)[[/if]][[if test="is(E1=\"r90\")"]]rotation of \(90^\circ\) anticlockwise about O[[/if]][[if test="is(E1=\"r180\")"]]rotation of \(180^\circ\) about O[[/if]][[if test="is(E1=\"r270\")"]]rotation of \(90^\circ\) clockwise about O[[/if]] does not bring the shape back. Reflecting in the same line again does.[[else]]A half turn is undone by another half turn: the rotation of \(180^\circ\) about O is its own inverse.[[/if]][[/if]][[/if]]

falsefeedback.text: [[if test="is(ans1=\"noinv1\")"]]Every reflection, rotation about O and enlargement with a non-zero scale factor can be undone: its matrix has a determinant that is not 0. [[/if]][[if test="is(R1=\"enl\" and ans1=\"ek1\")"]]Doing the same enlargement again gives scale factor \({@kk@} \times {@kk@} = {@kk^2@}\), not 1. [[/if]][[if test="is(R1=\"enl\" and ans1=\"emrk1\")"]]Your scale factor has the wrong sign: a negative scale factor also turns the shape through \(180^\circ\) about O. [[/if]][[if test="is(R1#\"enl\" and (ans1=\"ek1\" or ans1=\"emk1\" or ans1=\"erk1\" or ans1=\"emrk1\"))"]]An enlargement changes the size of a shape, but this transformation does not, so its inverse does not either. [[/if]][[if test="is(R1=\"enl\")"]]An enlargement, centre O, with scale factor k is undone by the enlargement, centre O, with scale factor \(\frac{1}{k}\).[[else]]The inverse sends every image point back to where it came from. A reflection is undone by the same reflection; a rotation is undone by turning through the same angle the other way.[[/if]]
